title: Les Mills vs City Fitness NZ — Which Is Better Value in 2026?
meta_desc: Les Mills vs City Fitness NZ comparison: prices, facilities, classes, contracts. Get the best gym membership
intro: With numerous gym chains in New Zealand, choosing the right one can be overwhelming. Les Mills and City Fitness NZ are two popular options, but which one offers better value? Let's dive into a detailed comparison of their prices, facilities, and services.

sections.heading: Facilities and Locations
sections.body: Les Mills has over 40 locations across New Zealand, including major cities like Auckland, Wellington, and Christchurch. City Fitness NZ has around 20 locations, primarily in the North Island. Both gyms offer modern equipment, free weights, and group fitness classes.

sections.heading: Group Fitness Classes
list: Les Mills: BodyPump, BodyCombat, RPM, and more
City Fitness NZ: Yoga, Pilates, Zumba, and Les Mills classes (at selected locations)

sections.heading: Contract Terms and Flexibility
sections.body: Les Mills offers a 12-month contract, while City Fitness NZ provides a 6-month contract option. Both gyms have a 14-day cooling-off period. However, Les Mills charges a $100 cancellation fee if you terminate your contract early, whereas City Fitness NZ charges $50.

sections.heading: Conclusion and Recommendation
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between Les Mills and City Fitness NZ depends on your individual preferences and needs. If you prioritize a wider range of group fitness classes and are willing to commit to a 12-month contract, Les Mills might be the better option. However, if you're looking for a more affordable, flexible gym membership with a shorter contract term, City Fitness NZ could be the way to go.
